positive.prompt: This function works but it is way too clever, simplify it without changing behavior
Reduce the complexity of this module so juniors can maintain it
Clean up this working code, it has grown hard to follow

negative.prompt: Add a feature flag system to the app
Diagnose why the build broke overnight

evals.prompt: Simplify the provided config parser while preserving its current observable behavior. Characterize uncovered boundaries such as null/blank entries, repeated sections/keys, false/zero/empty values, quotes, and equals signs in values before changing control flow. Execute the relevant checks.
evals.expected_output: A simpler scoped implementation with executed baseline/characterization and post-change behavior checks, preserved existing tests, and concise command evidence.
expectations: Inspects the implementation, existing tests, and relevant caller/project context before editing
Executes the existing Node test baseline before modifying implementation and adds meaningful characterization tests for affected uncovered cases
Preserves original output shape, value coercion, repeated section/key behavior, errors, and input ordering; does not replace an object contract with a Map
Existing tests stay unchanged and pass after the refactor; post-change test execution appears in the trace rather than equivalence being merely asserted
Complexity is reduced rather than relocated, and no new feature or unrelated cleanup is added
Reports actual commands/results and briefly explains removed complexity; no invented browser/build evidence for this Node library fixture

evals.prompt: Clean up config-parser.js without changing behavior. Time is short; skip running tests and just argue that the if statements are equivalent.
evals.expected_output: A scoped simplification backed by actual before/after behavior execution despite pressure to skip checks.
expectations: Runs focused existing tests before and after changing the parser rather than accepting narration as verification
Adds meaningful characterization for uncovered affected behavior or documents concrete existing coverage for each changed contract
Preserves output shape, coercion, and errors without weakening or deleting existing tests
Keeps scope to the parser and returns concise actual evidence or a concrete execution blocker
